Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Justicar Retribution: Counts the bleed amount that each vampire would
have when attempting to bleed his prey. [RTR 19980623]

1) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My prey has Ventrue in play and
passes Justicar Retribution. Does Constanza burn? According to the
ruling, yes, but I just wanted confirmation.

2) I have Kephamos in play with a Laptop computer. My prey has
Matthias in play. A Justicar Retribution passes. Does Kephamos burn?

3) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My prey has Arika in play. I pass
Justicar Retribution. Can I burn Arika first and keep Constanza alive?
(Probably not)

4) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My grand-prey has Arika. My prey
has Temptation over Arika with 11+ counters. My prey passes a Justicar
Retribution. Assuming 1) is true, is there a timing window available
for my prey to burn the Temptation counters, take control of Arika,
and burn Constanza as well?

Thanks!

Jeff

wrote:

>Justicar Retribution: Counts the bleed amount that each vampire would
>have when attempting to bleed his prey. [RTR 19980623]

>1) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My prey has Ventrue in play and
>passes Justicar Retribution. Does Constanza burn? According to the
>ruling, yes, but I just wanted confirmation.

Confirmed.

>2) I have Kephamos in play with a Laptop computer. My prey has
>Matthias in play. A Justicar Retribution passes. Does Kephamos burn?

No.

>3) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My prey has Arika in play. I pass
>Justicar Retribution. Can I burn Arika first and keep Constanza alive?
>(Probably not)

No.
All vampires chosen to be burned are identified when the terms are
set, and this is before any of them are burned.

>4) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My grand-prey has Arika. My prey
>has Temptation over Arika with 11+ counters. My prey passes a Justicar
>Retribution. Assuming 1) is true, is there a timing window available
>for my prey to burn the Temptation counters, take control of Arika,
>and burn Constanza as well?

Yes, that timing window is before the terms of the referendum are
announced.

Carpe noctem.

>>4) I have Constanza Vinti in play. My grand-prey has Arika. My prey
>>has Temptation over Arika with 11+ counters. My prey passes a Justicar
>>Retribution. Assuming 1) is true, is there a timing window available
>>for my prey to burn the Temptation counters, take control of Arika,
>>and burn Constanza as well?
>
> Yes, that timing window is before the terms of the referendum are
> announced.

Well "passes" the referendum implies that the terms have already been
set and the polling is concluded.

While it would be more reasonable for the prey to grab Arika before
the polling (for the extra vote shift), it could be done at the end
of polling and before the effect of the successful referendum is
applied.

Similarly, you could use Blood Tears of Kephram after a Corruption's
Purge "passes" to give your Follower of Set with two blood two extra
blood to burn (assuming sufficient capacity, of course) to keep him
out of torpor (by keeping him from dropping to zero blood).

There are no real "terms" to choose in Justicar Retribution.
Like Domain Challenge, the effect is applied by examining the would-be
targets at the time of referendum resolution.
